company.name: Kong
company.shortDescription: Kong Inc. is the AI connectivity company building the layer AI needs to reach its full potential with AI governance from day one.
company.description: Kong Inc. is the AI connectivity company. Its mission is to build the connectivity layer AI needs to reach its full potential with AI governance from day one. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified platform enables organizations to secure, govern, accelerate, and monetize the flow of intelligence across AI and API traffic — on any model, any cloud.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based API and AI connectivity platform for managing API gateways, AI traffic, event integrations, governance, analytics, developer access, and monetization.
productsAndServices.name: Kong Konnect

productsAndServices.description: A gateway for governing and routing LLM, agent, and MCP traffic with access control, prompt protection, token limits, semantic caching, provider routing, and AI observability.
productsAndServices.name: Kong AI Gateway

productsAndServices.description: An API gateway for routing, securing, transforming, and observing API traffic across cloud-native, hybrid, and self-managed environments.
productsAndServices.name: Kong Gateway

productsAndServices.description: A gateway for exposing and governing event-streaming traffic, including Kafka, with authentication, encryption, failover, routing, and controlled access beyond broker networks.
productsAndServices.name: Kong Event Gateway

productsAndServices.description: An API development and testing client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and related protocols, with environments, collections, mock servers, automation, plugins, and API design governance.
productsAndServices.name: Kong Insomnia

productsAndServices.description: A service mesh for managing service-to-service connectivity, traffic policies, security, and observability across Kubernetes, containers, virtual machines, and multi-zone environments.
productsAndServices.name: Kong Mesh

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $175,000,000, or 50.86% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,400,000,000 to $2,000,000,000, a 1.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
